title: BedSMP plugin
description: This plugin makes it so when you spawn in the world you get a death bed and if you don’t place it down you’re on hardcore but if you place it down your on survival!
body:
When you spawn in to the world you get a death bed and when its placed your on survival when its not your on hardcore. The bed is also has infinite fire and blast protection. The plugin only works with a paid copy of minecraft java.

If someone breaks your bed it doesnt drop and its not craftable, but if you break it, it drops.

Theres also a revival bed and you place it and chose who to revive. 

You can use commands with:
/Deathbed give
/Deathbed recipe
The recipe command can everyone use but the give command can only use a player with operator commands (/op).
